name: JCC Camp Ruach
description_short: JCC day camp in Bridgewater, open to families of any background, for ages 3 through 9th grade. Campers swim twice a day and rotate through sports, art, a ropes course and electives; grades 4 to 9 take day trips twice a week to places like the beach and amusement parks.
notes: 2027 non-member (camp fee) tuition by program, 4 to 8 weeks: K'ton ages 2 to 4 half or full days $2,170 to $5,775; Yeladim K to 1 $3,650 to $6,320; Gadol grades 2 to 3 $4,680 to $6,370; Tzahov grades 4 to 6 $5,150 to $7,000; Sababa grades 7 to 9 $5,220 to $7,065; Road Rulz grades 7 to 9 $6,050 to $8,300; LIT grades 8 to 9 $3,470 to $4,700. JCC members pay $550 less for most programs (for example Gadol 8 weeks $5,820 member, $6,370 non-member); the camp fee covers the first child and siblings get the member rate. $250 off if registered before December 31. Early care and late stay cost extra. Specialty Camp August 16 to 20 is $700 for non-Ruach campers, $650 for Ruach campers. Hours 9:00 to 4:00.
